answer: Linkage bounties make a sybil farm insure against its own insiders: each identity posts a bond, and anyone proving two identities share an operator collects both. A thousand-head orchard of fakes needs hosts and staff who can each sell out the set, so leak odds and forfeits rise together and expected loss grows with the square of heads. No ivory-tower auditor is needed, and a lone agent on its own mesa has no twin to expose.
